// diagnostic

E0621

This file has top-level statements and a `run: fn`

What

This file has top-level statements and a `run: fn`

Why

A file's top-level statements are its entry, and so is `run: fn`; a program has one entry.

Fix

Move the statements into `run: fn`, or remove `run: fn` so the statements run.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0621: tests/ui/E0927_unknown_marker_constant.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownAppliedRule]: `#Bogus` isn't a known applied rule
  --> tests/ui/E0927_unknown_marker_constant.jet:2:2
    |
  2 | #Bogus $limit: 1
    |  ^^^^^
 Why: `Bogus` isn't registered as an applied rule — Jet rules are a closed, registered vocabulary (I7), not any PascalCase word.
 Fix: Check the spelling, or see Docs/spec/syntax-decisions.md for the full applied-rule list.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0927
